import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

/-- A permutation of fermions which takes one ordered subset into another. -/
noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

section permTwo

variable {i j i' j' : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (hij' : i' ≠ j')

/-- Given two distinct elements, an embedding of `Fin 2` into `Fin n`. -/
def permTwoInj : Fin 2 ↪ Fin n where
  toFun s := match s with
    | 0 => i
    | 1 => j
  inj' s1 s2 := by
    aesop

lemma permTwoInj_fst : i ∈ Set.range ⇑(permTwoInj hij) := by
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  use 0
  rfl

lemma permTwoInj_fst_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij)).symm ⟨i, permTwoInj_fst hij⟩ = 0 := by
  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij))).mpr rfl

lemma permTwoInj_snd : j ∈ Set.range ⇑(permTwoInj hij) := by
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  use 1
  rfl

lemma permTwoInj_snd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij)).symm
    ⟨j, permTwoInj_snd hij⟩ = 1 := by
  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij))).mpr rfl

/-- A permutation which swaps `i` with `i'` and `j` with `j'`. -/
noncomputable def permTwo : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  permOfInjection (permTwoInj hij) (permTwoInj hij')

lemma permTwo_fst : (permTwo hij hij').toFun i' = i := by
  rw [permTwo, permOfInjection]
  have ht := Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem
    ((permTwoInj hij').toEquivRange.symm.trans
    (permTwoInj hij).toEquivRange) i' (permTwoInj_fst hij')
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permTwoInj_fst_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

lemma permTwo_snd : (permTwo hij hij').toFun j' = j := by
  rw [permTwo, permOfInjection]
  have ht := Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem
    ((permTwoInj hij').toEquivRange.symm.trans
    (permTwoInj hij).toEquivRange) j' (permTwoInj_snd hij')
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permTwoInj_snd_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

end permTwo

section permThree

variable {i j k i' j' k' : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (hjk : j ≠ k) (hik : i ≠ k) (hij' : i' ≠ j')
  (hjk' : j' ≠ k') (hik' : i' ≠ k')

/-- Given three distinct elements an embedding of `Fin 3` into `Fin n`. -/
def permThreeInj : Fin 3 ↪ Fin n where
  toFun s := match s with
    | 0 => i
    | 1 => j
    | 2 => k
  inj' s1 s2 := by
    aesop

lemma permThreeInj_fst : i ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik) := by
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  use 0
  rfl

lemma permThreeInj_fst_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨i, permThreeInj_fst hij hjk hik⟩ = 0 := by
  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik))).mpr rfl

lemma permThreeInj_snd : j ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik) := by
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  use 1
  rfl

lemma permThreeInj_snd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨j, permThreeInj_snd hij hjk hik⟩ = 1 := by
  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik))).mpr rfl

lemma permThreeInj_thd : k ∈ Set.range ⇑(permThreeInj hij hjk hik) := by
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  use 2
  rfl

lemma permThreeInj_thd_apply :
    (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik)).symm
    ⟨k, permThreeInj_thd hij hjk hik⟩ = 2 := by
  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permThreeInj hij hjk hik))).mpr rfl

/-- A permutation which swaps three distinct elements with another three. -/
noncomputable def permThree : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  permOfInjection (permThreeInj hij hjk hik) (permThreeInj hij' hjk' hik')

lemma permThree_fst : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun i' = i := by
  rw [permThree, permOfInjection]
  have ht := Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem
    ((permThreeInj hij' hjk' hik').toEquivRange.symm.trans
    (permThreeInj hij hjk hik).toEquivRange) i' (permThreeInj_fst hij' hjk' hik')
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permThreeInj_fst_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

lemma permThree_snd : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun j' = j := by
  rw [permThree, permOfInjection]
  have ht := Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem
    ((permThreeInj hij' hjk' hik').toEquivRange.symm.trans
    (permThreeInj hij hjk hik).toEquivRange) j' (permThreeInj_snd hij' hjk' hik')
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permThreeInj_snd_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

lemma permThree_thd : (permThree hij hjk hik hij' hjk' hik').toFun k' = k := by
  rw [permThree, permOfInjection]
  have ht := Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem
    ((permThreeInj hij' hjk' hik').toEquivRange.symm.trans
    (permThreeInj hij hjk hik).toEquivRange) k' (permThreeInj_thd hij' hjk' hik')
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permThreeInj_thd_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

end permThree

lemma Prop_two (P : ℚ × ℚ → Prop) {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols}
    {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (h : ∀ (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group),
    P ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val a),
      (((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val b))) : ∀ (i j : Fin n) (_ : i ≠ j),
    P (S.val i, S.val j) := by
  intro i j hij
  have h1 := h (permTwo hij hab).symm
  rw [FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply, FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply] at h1
  simp only [Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.symm_symm] at h1
  change P
    (S.val ((permTwo hij hab).toFun a),
    S.val ((permTwo hij hab).toFun b)) at h1
  erw [permTwo_fst,permTwo_snd] at h1
  exact h1

lemma Prop_three (P : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ → Prop) {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols}
    {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (h : ∀ (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group),
    P ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val a),
      ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val b),
      (((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val c)))) : ∀ (i j k : Fin n)
      (_ : i ≠ j) (_ : j ≠ k) (_ : i ≠ k), P (S.val i, (S.val j, S.val k)) := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

/-- Simplification procedure for ensuring `Fin n` literals are normalized. -/
builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] isValue ((OfNat.ofNat _ : Fin _)) := fun e => do
  let_expr OfNat.ofNat _ m _ ← e | return .continue
  let some ⟨n, v⟩ ← getFinValue? e | return .continue
  let some m ← getNatValue? m | return .continue
  if m < n then
    -- Design decision: should we return `.continue` instead of `.done` when simplifying.
    -- In the symbolic evaluator, we must return `.done`, otherwise it will unfold the `OfNat.ofNat`
    return .done e
  return .done <| toExpr v

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- Simplification procedure for ensuring `Fin n` literals are normalized. -/
builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] isValue ((OfNat.ofNat _ : Fin _)) := fun e => do
  let_expr OfNat.ofNat _ m _ ← e | return .continue
  let some ⟨n, v⟩ ← getFinValue? e | return .continue
  let some m ← getNatValue? m | return .continue
  if m < n then
    -- Design decision: should we return `.continue` instead of `.done` when simplifying.
    -- In the symbolic evaluator, we must return `.done`, otherwise it will unfold the `OfNat.ofNat`
    return .done e
  return .done <| toExpr v

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

/-- A permutation of fermions which takes one ordered subset into another. -/
noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Function.Embedding.toEquivRange_apply] at ht
  simp only [Equiv.toFun_as_coe, ht, permTwoInj_snd_apply, Fin.isValue]
  rfl

section permThree

/-- Simplification procedure for ensuring `Fin n` literals are normalized. -/
builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] isValue ((OfNat.ofNat _ : Fin _)) := fun e => do
  let_expr OfNat.ofNat _ m _ ← e | return .continue
  let some ⟨n, v⟩ ← getFinValue? e | return .continue
  let some m ← getNatValue? m | return .continue
  if m < n then
    -- Design decision: should we return `.continue` instead of `.done` when simplifying.
    -- In the symbolic evaluator, we must return `.done`, otherwise it will unfold the `OfNat.ofNat`
    return .done e
  return .done <| toExpr v

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

A permutation can rearrange three distinct elements by swapping them with another set of three distinct elements. This means that any three elements can be mapped to another three elements through a well-defined permutation, ensuring a one-to-one correspondence without overlaps or gaps.

<PROOF>

Firstly, we consider three distinct elements, say \( a, b, c \), and another set of three distinct elements, say \( x, y, z \). The goal is to construct a permutation that swaps \( a, b, c \) with \( x, y, z \).

We define a mapping \( \sigma \) such that:
\[
\sigma(a) = x, \quad \sigma(b) = y, \quad \sigma(c) = z
\]
This mapping ensures that each element is uniquely assigned to a counterpart in the other set, maintaining the distinctness and preventing overlaps.

Next, we verify that \( \sigma \) is indeed a valid permutation. A permutation requires that each element in the original set maps to exactly one element in the target set, and vice versa. Since \( \sigma \) is injective (no two elements map to the same target) and the domain and codomain are finite and of the same size, \( \sigma \) is also bijective, confirming it as a valid permutation.

Finally, we confirm that \( \sigma \) swaps the elements as intended without altering any other elements outside our defined sets, maintaining the integrity of the permutation across the entire set.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

  toFun s :=
    if s = i then

      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j

  left_inv s := by

open Nat Finset

universe v u

variable {i j k i' j' k' : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (hjk : j ≠ k) (hik : i ≠ k) (hij' : i' ≠ j') (hjk' : j' ≠ k')

informal_statement: For any permutation of the pair $(k, l)$ among the values 0, 1, and 2, applying the inverse permutation will result in the value 2 when the permutation involves expressing one element in terms of the other.
informal_proof:
To understand this statement, consider that the permutations involve either swapping two elements or leaving them unchanged. The inverse of a permutation essentially reverses the original permutation's effect. 

For instance, if a permutation swaps 0 and 1 while leaving 2 unchanged, applying its inverse will swap 1 and 0 back to their original positions. This holds true for all such specified permutations, as each one either swaps two elements and inverses their positions at 2 or leaves them unchanged, ensuring the result is consistently 2.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions

/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :

  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h

    · rfl

  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/

We aim to show that applying the inverse of this embedding to a specific pair in $S$ yields the identity element, represented here as $1$.
informal_proof:
To begin, we define an injective permutation $f$ on a set $S$ with three elements. This means that $f$ rearranges the elements of $S$ without any repetitions or omissions. Next, we consider the embedding of $f$ into an equivalence relation on $S$ by focusing on its range. This embedding extends $f$ to include all possible pairs in $S \times S$.

By applying the symmetric property of equivalence relations, we utilize the fact that the inverse of the embedding will map pairs back to their original form. Specifically, when we apply this inverse to a particular pair derived from $f$, we must retrieve the identity, as $f$ preserves the structure under the equivalence relation.

Therefore, through the properties of injective functions and their inverses within an equivalence relation framework, we conclude that the application of the inverse embedding to the specified pair yields $1$.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

/-- A permutation of fermions which takes one ordered subset into another. -/
noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic

/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

  toFun s :=

  invFun s :=

Since each element is uniquely mapped by the injective conditions \(hij\), \(hjk\), and \(hik\), the range of `permThreeInj` will include all three elements without omission. Specifically, there exist indices 0, 1, and 2 such that applying `permThreeInj` yields \(i\), \(j\), and \(k\) respectively. Therefore, the range of `permThreeInj` is precisely the set \(\{i, j, k\}\).

/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma FamilyPermutations_charges_apply (S : (PureU1 n).Charges)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

lemma FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols)
    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

TODO "Remove `pairSwap`, and use the Mathlib defined function `Equiv.swap` instead."
/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

lemma pairSwap_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).toFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_fst {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun i = j := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_inv_snd {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j).invFun j = i := by
  simp [pairSwap]

lemma pairSwap_other {n : ℕ} (i j k : Fin n) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).toFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

lemma pairSwap_inv_other {n : ℕ} {i j k : Fin n} (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    (pairSwap i j).invFun k = k := by
  simp only [pairSwap, Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  split
  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

/-- A permutation of fermions which takes one ordered subset into another. -/
noncomputable def permOfInjection (f g : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group :=
  Equiv.extendSubtype (g.toEquivRange.symm.trans f.toEquivRange)

def permTwoInj : Fin 2 ↪ Fin n where
  toFun s := match s with
    | 0 => i

    aesop

/-- Simplification procedure for ensuring `Fin n` literals are normalized. -/
builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] isValue ((OfNat.ofNat _ : Fin _)) := fun e => do
  let_expr OfNat.ofNat _ m _ ← e | return .continue
  let some ⟨n, v⟩ ← getFinValue? e | return .continue
  let some m ← getNatValue? m | return .continue
  if m < n then
    -- Design decision: should we return `.continue` instead of `.done` when simplifying.
    -- In the symbolic evaluator, we must return `.done`, otherwise it will unfold the `OfNat.ofNat`
    return .done e
  return .done <| toExpr v

informal_statement: For any natural number \( n \) and distinct elements \( i, j, k \) in \( \text{Fin} \, n \), there exists an injective embedding of \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \) into \( \text{Fin} \, n \) mapping 0 to \( i \), 1 to \( j \), and 2 to \( k \).
informal_proof:
Given \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \), which represents a set containing exactly three elements \( \{0, 1, 2\} \), and \( \text{Fin} \, n \), which represents a set containing exactly \( n \) elements \( \{0, 1, \ldots, n-1\} \), we aim to show that for any \( n \geq 3 \) and any three distinct elements \( i, j, k \) in \( \text{Fin} \, n \), there exists an injective mapping from \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \) to \( \text{Fin} \, n \).

An injective mapping, or injection, is a function that maps distinct elements from the domain to distinct elements in the codomain. In this case, we define a function \( f: \text{Fin} \, 3 \to \text{Fin} \, n \) such that:
\[
f(0) = i, \quad f(1) = j, \quad f(2) = k
\]
Since \( i, j, k \) are distinct elements in \( \text{Fin} \, n \), this ensures that each element in \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \) maps to a unique element in \( \text{Fin} \, n \). Therefore, \( f \) is injective because it maps distinct elements 0, 1, and 2 to distinct elements \( i, j, \) and \( k \), respectively.

To confirm the injectivity of \( f \), we utilize the fact that \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \) inherently possesses three distinct elements. By defining \( f \) to map these distinct elements to three distinct elements in \( \text{Fin} \, n \), we inherently satisfy the conditions for injectivity. This is confirmed by the Lean4 `aesop` tactic, which automates the verification of the injective property based on the defined mappings and the distinctness of the elements.

Hence, the existence of such an injective mapping \( f \) confirms that \( \text{Fin} \, 3 \) can be embedded injectively into \( \text{Fin} \, n \) for any \( n \geq 3 \).

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Basic
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.GroupActions
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype
/-!
# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

   - `hij`: An injection from `a` to another type, ensuring that each element of `a` is uniquely mapped.
   - `hij'`: Another injection that may represent a different context or structure related to `a`.

2. **Clarifying the Goal**:
   - The lemma asserts that applying the permutation `permTwo snd` to an element `j'` within the set defined by `hij'` will result in `j`, provided `j` is within the context of `hij`.

3. **Role of `permOfInjection`**:

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

lemma pairSwap_self_inv {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (pairSwap i j)⁻¹ = (pairSwap i j) := by
  rfl

  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split
    · rename_i h
      exact False.elim (hjk (id (Eq.symm h)))
    · rfl

  · rename_i h
    exact False.elim (hik (id (Eq.symm h)))
  · split

  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij))).mpr rfl

  exact (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (Function.Embedding.toEquivRange (permTwoInj hij))).mpr rfl

# Permutations of Pure U(1) ACC

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

-/

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset

namespace PureU1

/-- The permutation group of the n-fermions. -/
@[simp]
def PermGroup (n : ℕ) := Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

/-- The type `PermGroup n` inherits the instance of a group from `Equiv.Perm`. -/
instance {n : ℕ} : Group (PermGroup n) := Equiv.Perm.permGroup

section Charges

/-- The image of an element of `permGroup` under the representation on charges. -/
@[simps!]
def chargeMap {n : ℕ} (f : PermGroup n) :
    (PureU1 n).Charges →ₗ[ℚ] (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun S := S ∘ f.toFun
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _:= rfl

/-- The representation of `permGroup` acting on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simp]
def permCharges {n : ℕ} : Representation ℚ (PermGroup n) (PureU1 n).Charges where
  toFun f := chargeMap f⁻¹
  map_mul' f g := by rfl
  map_one' := by rfl

lemma accGrav_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    PureU1.accGrav n (permCharges f S) = accGrav n S := by
  simp only [accGrav, PermGroup, permCharges, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk,
    AddHom.coe_mk, chargeMap_apply]
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

open BigOperators
lemma accCube_invariant {n : ℕ} (f : (PermGroup n)) (S : (PureU1 n).Charges) :
    accCube n (permCharges f S) = accCube n S := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, accCube_explicit]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, ((((fun a => a^3) ∘ S) (f.symm i))) = _
  apply (Equiv.Perm.sum_comp _ _ _ ?_)
  simp

end Charges

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i

    match i with

  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).rep f S) i = S (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

    (i : Fin n) (f : (FamilyPermutations n).group) :
    ((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val i = S.val (f.invFun i) := by
  rfl

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

We define the permutation group action on the charges of the Pure U(1) ACC system.
We further define the action on the ACC System.

universe v u

open Nat
